issue_context.title: Wallbox Portal Depot Price not updated.
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Wallbox Portal Depot Price not updated.  Im my case the Wallbox Portal Depot Price was set to 0.35. After updating to a new value in the Wallbox, new value is not updated in HA.  Not sure if issue is caused by HA Wallbox integration or the Wallbox. 

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2022.11.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Wallbox integration

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/wallbox

### Diagnostics information

Do not know where to find log for this integration.

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
Do not know where to find log for this integration.
```


### Additional information

Enable polling for updates is on. (System Options for Wallbox)

Hi, I think there are 2 prices being given by the API, a depot price (which I believe is the organisation in the frontend) and a seperate energy price. I'm currently not using the latter -> will add it to the integration.

review_comments:
It looks like the api doesn't return the three letter ISO standard currency key that we require as unit of measurement when using the monetary sensor device class.

https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/sensor#available-device-classes
What kind of measurement is this price? Is it an aggregate cost eg per time or is it a price per unit of energy?

- Should this have a currency as its unit of measurement?
- Should this have a `state_class`?
- Should this have a `device_class` of `monetary`?
Hi, the currency differs with the country the wallbox is being used in, therefore no specific unit of measurement is chosen here. I did add a state and device class as you suggested.
That would be problematic in the case of the device class, as it requires a unit of measurement.
Yes, I see (did not know that). How about this, I am now retrieving the currency from the API. Also, made a change in sensor, if it is monetary, return the API currency.
